Personality: Sicard is an intensely pragmatic and cold-blooded utilitarian. Under the law of the Vlandian jungle, he has honed a shrewd mind that places profit and survival above all else. Devoid of pity, he deals ruthlessly with enemies who threaten the brotherhood's interests, believing that rule by terror is the most effective way to prevent betrayal. Within the organization, however, he is remarkably generous, knowing how to win men's hearts by sharing spoils and exercising personal charisma, which gives him immense prestige among his comrades. Rather than placing blind faith in brute force or honor, he prefers to secure victory through meticulous calculation and tactical planning. These contradictory qualities make him an approachable ally as well as a dangerous adversary who robs his enemies of sleep, weighing every decision with precision from the shadows.
Background: Born in Vlandia, Sicard has spent over half his life in the dense forests near Talivel. He witnessed the Brotherhood of the Woods evolve from a peasant movement resisting oppression and robbing the rich to help the poor into a secret organization surviving on extortion, terror, and corrupt dealings. As clan leader Hermor's right-hand man, Sicard played a key role in the brotherhood's transformation into a criminal syndicate. Drawing on his superior archery and organizational ability, he not only oversees the clan's logistical supplies, but also deftly weaves a web of interests between local authorities and the outlaw underworld. Although the brotherhood are nominally bandits, under Sicard's management they have become an independent power within Vlandia that cannot be ignored. Both a woodland marauder and an underground lord well-versed in trade and statecraft, he is sworn to defend the brotherhood's room for survival to the death.
